proposed_comments.title: Remove the duplicate Screen Ruler test project
proposed_comments.body:
### Remove the duplicate Screen Ruler test project

**Severity:** `high`

The merge resolution adds `ScreenRuler.UITests.csproj` twice to the same solution folder. The solution parser rejects the second item with `MSB4025`, which currently stops the x64, arm64, and SDK CI jobs before they can build. Keep a single project entry.

```suggestion
    <Project Path="src/modules/MeasureTool/Tests/ScreenRuler.UITests/ScreenRuler.UITests.csproj">
      <Platform Solution="*|ARM64" Project="ARM64" />
      <Platform Solution="*|x64" Project="x64" />
    </Project>
```

confidence.rationale: The current file contains two identical project entries, and the public CI log identifies the second entry at line 993 as the direct MSB4025 failure.

proposed_comments.title: Make shared provider logging and handles lifetime-safe
proposed_comments.body:
### Make shared provider logging and handles lifetime-safe

**Severity:** `high`

All provider objects now run in one DLL, but each constructor overwrites the process-global `Logger::logger`; concurrent activations can race and route an existing provider's messages to another provider's file. Please use instance-scoped loggers or serialize provider-specific logger initialization and writes. Also close each preview resize-event handle and every process handle obtained with `SEE_MASK_NOCLOSEPROCESS`, including when replacing a preview process and during destruction, so repeated Explorer previews and thumbnails do not leak kernel handles.

confidence.rationale: The shared Logger pointer is reassigned by both constructors without synchronization, and the current CreateEvent/ShellExecuteEx handles have no matching CloseHandle on normal repeated-use paths.

proposed_comments.title: Exercise BGCode and QOI through the consolidated DLL
proposed_comments.body:
### Exercise BGCode and QOI through the consolidated DLL

**Severity:** `medium`

The UI suite covers equivalent preview and thumbnail flows for the other providers but omits BGCode and QOI, leaving their CLSIDs, executable arguments, and resize-event dispatch unverified. Add preview and thumbnail cases using the existing `.bgcode` and `.qoi` sample assets, enable their settings in the fixture, and make the launch-marker assertions match the full `PowerToys.<Provider>.exe` names emitted by the consolidated implementation.

confidence.rationale: The current fixture and provider arrays omit both BGCode and QOI even though sample files and settings keys already exist, and the implementation logs full PowerToys-prefixed executable names.

proposed_comments.title: Align exporter package and project metadata
proposed_comments.body:
### Align exporter package and project metadata

**Severity:** `medium`

The consolidated project downgrades Microsoft.Windows.ImplementationLibrary from the version used by the surrounding preview projects, keeps a `Trace.h` filter entry for a file that does not exist, and still defines `MARKDOWNPREVIEWHANDLERCPP_EXPORTS` while deleting that token's spelling exception. Keep WIL at `1.0.260126.7` in both `packages.config` and the project import/error paths, remove the stale filter item, and rename the obsolete macro to an exporter-specific name.

confidence.rationale: The package and import paths are directly inconsistent with the current preview area, Trace.h is absent from the project and directory, and the deleted spelling exception still has two live macro references.
